## Description

A `Stack.Host` is integrated with a `Split.Column` only when it is the direct and only child of the column. In this scenario the secondary column renders a `FormSheet`, and the sheet renders the stack. The column does not set `disableStackIntegration`. The stack has to be an ordinary nested stack: it is shown inside the sheet, with its own navigation bar, and it navigates there.

It guards against the stack asking the column to take it over. The column does not take over a stack that is not its direct child, so such a stack would not be shown at all.

## Note

- The scenario has to be rendered as the root of the app: import `TestSplitStackV5InFormSheet` as `Example` in `apps/App.tsx`. The Split is a top-level navigator, and the tests menu would push the scenario onto a stack.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Start the app with **TestSplitStackV5InFormSheet** as its root.

    - [ ] The primary column shows "Primary column".
    - [ ] The secondary column shows "Plain column" with the "Open sheet" button.

2. Tap "Open sheet".

    - [ ] A sheet opens and shows the "Nested root" screen with the navigation bar of the stack, titled "Nested root".
    - [ ] No error is logged.

3. Tap "Push Nested pushed".

    - [ ] "Nested pushed" is pushed inside the sheet, with a back button in the navigation bar of the stack.

4. Tap "Pop".

    - [ ] The sheet shows "Nested root" again.

---

### Dismissing the sheet

1. Drag the sheet down until it is dismissed.

    - [ ] The secondary column shows "Plain column" with the "Open sheet" button again.
